## Fitpal — Reconcile (PROD + DEV)

### ⚠️ Set the token in the «Token» node — ONE place, both envs
Paste the value of `RECONCILE_TRIGGER_TOKEN` (Netlify env var) into the Set node.
Both HTTP nodes read it from there, so there is no second copy to forget.

### Why /reconcile-run and not /viva-reconcile
`viva-reconcile` and `airtable-reconcile` are Netlify **scheduled** functions.
Netlify: *"You can't invoke scheduled functions directly with a URL."*
Calling them over HTTP returns a bare **403** — which is what the previous
version of this workflow did, every 15 min, silently, since it was created.
`reconcile-run` is deliberately NOT scheduled, so it is reachable, and it
calls the same two handlers. One implementation, not two.

### This is a SECOND trigger, on purpose
Netlify's own `*/5` cron runs these on **production only** (branch deploys
never run scheduled functions — so DEV has never had a reconcile at all).
Measured 2026-09-03: prod cron fires, but skipped **70 times in 48h,
worst gap 25.1 min**. Safe to double-fire — `markPaid` is a guarded
`UPDATE ... WHERE payment_status='pending'`.

### Error handling is asymmetric, deliberately
**DEV** node continues on failure — a dev outage must never stop the prod call.
**PROD** node uses the default, so a real failure turns the execution RED.
`reconcile-run` returns **500** if either provider throws, so a dead reconcile
shows up instead of hiding behind a green run.

### Verify — row-exists is NOT enough
```sql
select provider, max(run_at) filter (where errors = 0) as last_clean,
       count(*) filter (where errors > 0
         and run_at > now() - interval '1 day') as erroring_24h
from reconcile_runs group by provider;
```
WEC-695 (Viva OAuth) and WEC-537 (Airtable field) both ran for over a MONTH
writing rows with `errors: 13`. Always check `errors = 0`.

Source of truth: `n8n/` in the fitpal-site repo.
Linear: **WEC-696** (this endpoint) · **WEC-534** · **WEC-646** liveness alerting
